response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and backend systems, and his current role includes brief exposure to MCP tooling and agentic workflow infrastructure. However, the role explicitly requires 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, RAG architectures, vector databases, and multi-agent frameworks, none of which are substantively evidenced in his history beyond a few months at his current job. This is a core, non-negotiable requirement gap rather than a nice-to-have, making him a weak fit despite strong general engineering credentials.
strengths: 15+ years of proven, high-quality full-stack and systems engineering experience
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentorship, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of AI-driven solution development as required
No mention of RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/optimization experience
No experience with multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph or CrewAI, or enterprise AI technical discovery

key_factors.factor: Lack of required AI/GenAI domain experience (8+ yrs)
Strong general engineering seniority and recent MCP exposure
